title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a temporary general order banning the carrying of weapons and knives in a defined area around the Olympiastadion for a running event on 19 April 2026, from 7:00 to 16:30. No incident has been reported.
